title: 第905章 绝望的罗琨第904章 太渊图
content_zh:
荒兽天帝淡淡道：“龟煞，九元天那片区域有一个名叫罗琨的人类武者正在被追杀，实力在五级武圣上下，你速去解救他，将他直接带去玄湮界口。”
“是……”
龟煞荒兽点了点头，转身匆匆离开。
出了沧溟天，离开黑雾边境的途中，龟煞荒兽始终神情复杂，内心掀起一阵轩然大波。
“那个人类武者如此猖狂，杀了我们手下那么多荒兽，天帝大人非但不好好折磨报复他，还和他相处得如老友般融洽，甚至连他的朋友都命我前去解救……这个人类，身上究竟藏着怎样的惊天秘密，让天帝大人青睐到如此地步？”
龟煞荒兽飞出了黑雾边境，朝九元天的方向而去。
帝殿内，荒兽天帝悄然将苏辰净化完毕的荒芜之气，一一仔细检查了一番。
确认苏辰转化为成的帝玄晶中，没有动任何手脚，和真正的高阶武帝凝炼而出的帝玄晶相比看不出任何区别，荒兽天帝心中贪念大动，试探性道：“小子，既然你我此次合作如此融洽，不如再做笔交易如何？”
苏辰饶有趣味问道：“什么交易？”
“反正你马上就要离开黑雾深渊，不如就在临走之前，将你这门净化荒芜之气的秘法传授给本帝吧。”
荒兽天帝满脸恳切，诚意十足：“只要你愿意将这个秘法传授给我，整个黑雾深渊内的一切，你都可以带走！”
面对荒兽天帝这明显用意不纯的请求，苏辰冷笑一声，毫不犹豫摇头拒绝：“不可能。”
他很清楚，他身上唯一让荒兽天帝感兴趣，且可以用来交易的筹码，就只有净化荒芜之气这个能力。
如果荒兽天帝真的掌握了这门秘法，那他手中扣押的那三万枚帝玄晶便没有任何意义，荒兽天帝一定会撕毁先约，将他们永远困在黑雾深渊之中。
且不说这太渊晦墟，本就是一片资源匮乏的绝地，根本没有任何能入他法眼的资源，就算真有什么珍贵宝物，哪怕是那位开辟此方绝地的大人物遗留下的传承，苏辰也不会利益熏心到将护身保命的底牌交出来。
荒兽天帝也知道让苏辰交出这部秘法几乎不可能，只是抱着试试的心态提了一嘴，所以被拒绝也没有显得太过恼火，说道：
“你既然不愿意交易，那咱们可以换一个方式，只要本帝还身在太渊晦墟一日，就会一直源源不断地凝炼荒芜之气，如果你还有兴趣继续与本帝进行合作的话，十年后可以再回来一趟，到时候我们还可以像今日这样瓜分帝玄晶。”
苏辰点了点头，露出意味深长的笑容：“好，我一定会再回来的。”
等他的境界达到中阶武圣之后，当然会找机会重返一趟黑雾深渊，但绝不是为了再和荒兽天帝做这种与虎谋皮的交易。
因为到了那个阶段，自己的《九幽镇狱劲》进一步精进，帝玄晶很有可能都已经对他起不到任何作用。

若真有朝一日重返黑雾深渊，苏辰只会是为了一样事物感兴趣。
那就是，那名开辟这座黑雾深渊的神秘强者，以及他遗留下来的机缘传承。
……
与此同时，太渊晦墟中部区域，九元天。
罗琨正在慌张逃命，五头荒兽咬在他身后十几里的位置，杀气腾腾穷追不舍。
兽潮已经爆发了九天之久，各盟历经艰难血战，都已经损失惨重。
在兽潮爆发之前，任天绝率领副盟主杨叙，以及十几名实力达到五级武圣的队长和心腹，前往摩罗天围杀苏辰，却如泥牛入海般，一去便杳无音讯。
这场巨变，让他们绝渊盟的顶级战力几乎全部丧尽，却因祸得福，没有吸引来大首领级别的九阶巅峰荒兽、乃至十阶荒兽王者的袭击，反倒成为整个太渊晦墟损失相对最小的一个联盟。
当然，尽管最强大的一批荒兽不屑于对他们出手，单是一群九阶中期和后期的荒兽，也足够给绝渊盟带来灭顶之灾。
兽潮爆发的第三天，绝渊盟的大本营便在数百头荒兽的围攻下沦陷，副盟主陆九寒战死，盟内的成员死伤大半，幸存下来的被迫抛弃大本营四散而逃，却也失去了唯一的庇护，只能遭受荒兽们无穷无尽的追杀。
罗琨一个人单独行动，几乎将身上储备的丹药和宝物全部耗尽，才算是勉强又独自一人支撑了六天的时间。
但是，如今底牌用尽的他，不仅身负重伤，元力也近乎被榨干，也已然到了油尽灯枯的地步。
罗琨不甘心就这么憋屈地死在荒兽的血口之中，拖着重伤的身躯狼狈逃窜，想要寻找附近其他盟单独行动的强者寻求庇护。
唯一值得庆幸的是，身后那五头九阶中期荒兽，虽然一开始追杀得极为迅猛，但已经追了他整整两天之久，现在速度比他也快不了多少。
如果自己运气比较好，能在被追上之前，碰上愿意对自己施以援助的帮手，或许还能有一线生机……
原本罗琨还在求生欲的驱使下，强忍剧痛全力逃窜，既是为了有朝一日能逃出这个鬼地方重见天日的执念，也是为了自己心底那个尚未完成的愿望。
然而，当感受到一股前所未有的强横威压从他前方传来，并以恐怖的速度向他逼近，罗琨内心倏然一沉，彻底面如死灰般绝望。
“这股威压……是武帝级别的气势？”
罗琨脸色惨白，自嘲般喃喃自语道：“我不过是区区一阶中阶武圣，用得着十阶荒兽亲自出动截杀？这未免也太抬举我罗琨了，难道是我正好倒霉？也罢，能死在武帝级别实力的十阶荒兽王者手中，也没什么好不甘的，父皇，母亲，来世再见了！”
罗琨闭上了眼睛，安静等待死亡的到来。

面对这样的强敌，他甚至无法生起一丝反抗的勇气。
content_en:
The Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor said calmly: "Guisha, there is a human warrior named Luo Kun in the Jiuyuantian area who is being hunted. His strength is around the level of a fifth-level Martial Saint. Go and rescue him quickly and take him directly to the entrance to the Xuanyan Realm."
"Yes..."
The turtle beast nodded, turned around and left in a hurry.
After leaving Cangmingtian and leaving the border of black mist, the turtle beast always had a complicated expression, and there was a great uproar in his heart.
"That human warrior was so rampant and killed so many wild beasts under our control. Instead of torturing and retaliating against him, the Emperor of Heaven got along with him as harmoniously as an old friend. Even his friends ordered me to rescue him... What kind of shocking secret does this human being hide in his body that makes the Emperor of Heaven favor him so much?"
The turtle beast flew out of the black mist border and headed in the direction of Jiuyuantian.
In the Imperial Palace, the Desolate Beast Emperor quietly examined the desolate energy that Su Chen had purified one by one.
After confirming that the Emperor Xuan Crystal that Su Chen had transformed into had not been tampered with, and there was no difference between it and the Emperor Xuan Crystal condensed by a real high-level Martial Emperor, the Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor was moved by greed in his heart, and tentatively said: "Boy, since you and I are so harmonious in our cooperation this time, how about making another deal?"
Su Chen asked with interest: "What deal?"
"Anyway, you are about to leave the Black Mist Abyss. Why not teach this emperor your secret method of purifying the desolate air before leaving?"
The Desolate Beast Emperor's face was full of sincerity: "As long as you are willing to teach me this secret method, you can take away everything in the Black Mist Abyss!"
Facing the Desolate Beast Emperor's obviously impure request, Su Chen sneered and shook his head in refusal without hesitation: "Impossible."
He knew very well that the only bargaining chip in him that interested the Desolate Beast Emperor was the ability to purify the desolate air.
If the Desolate Beast Emperor really mastered this secret method, then the 30,000 Emperor Xuan Crystals he had seized would have no meaning. The Desolate Beast Emperor would definitely tear up the agreement and trap them in the black mist abyss forever.
Not to mention that Taiyuan Hui Ruins is a Jedi with scarce resources. There are no resources that can catch his eye. Even if there are any precious treasures, even if they are the inheritance left by the great man who opened up this Jedi, Su Chen will not be so interested in handing over his trump cards to protect himself and his life.
The Desolate Beast Emperor also knew that it was almost impossible for Su Chen to hand over this secret method. He just mentioned it with the intention of giving it a try, so he did not appear too annoyed when he was rejected and said:
"Since you are unwilling to trade, we can find another way. As long as I am still in Taiyuan Hui Ruins, I will continue to condense the energy of desolation. If you are still interested in continuing to cooperate with me, you can come back in ten years. Then we can divide the Emperor Xuan Crystal like we do today."
Su Chen nodded and showed a meaningful smile: "Okay, I will definitely come back again."
After he reaches the level of Intermediate Martial Saint, he will of course look for opportunities to return to the Black Mist Abyss, but it will definitely not be for the purpose of making such a deal with the Desolate Beast Emperor for the skin of a tiger.
Because at that stage, his "Nine Nether Prison Suppressing Power" has further improved, and the Emperor Xuan Crystal will most likely have no effect on him.
If Su Chen really returns to the Black Mist Abyss one day, he will only be interested in one thing.
That is, the mysterious strong man who opened up this black mist abyss, and the chance inheritance he left behind.
…
At the same time, in the central area of Taiyuan Huixu, Jiuyuantian.
Luo Kun was running for his life in a panic. Five wild beasts were biting him more than ten miles behind him, pursuing him with murderous intent.
The beast tide has been breaking out for nine days, and all the alliances have suffered heavy losses after going through difficult and bloody battles.
Before the beast tide broke out, Ren Tianjue led deputy alliance leader Yang Xu and more than a dozen powerfulThe captain and his confidants who had reached the fifth level of martial arts went to Moluotian to kill Su Chen, but like a mud cow drowning in the sea, there was no news as soon as they left.
This huge change almost wiped out all the top combat power of their Jueyuan Alliance. However, it was a blessing in disguise. It did not attract attacks from the ninth-order peak desolate beasts at the big leader level, or even the tenth-order desolate beast kings. Instead, it became the alliance with the least losses in the entire Taiyuan Huixu.
Of course, even though the most powerful group of desolate beasts disdain to attack them, a group of mid- to late-level ninth-order desolate beasts alone is enough to bring disaster to the Jueyuan Alliance.
On the third day when the beast tide broke out, the base camp of the Jueyuan Alliance fell under the siege of hundreds of wild beasts. The deputy leader Lu Jiuhan died in the battle, and most of the members of the alliance were killed or injured. Those who survived were forced to abandon the base camp and flee, but they also lost their only shelter and could only be endlessly hunted by the wild beasts.
Luo Kun acted alone and almost exhausted all the elixirs and treasures in his body before he could barely sustain himself for another six days.
However, now that he has exhausted all his cards, he is not only seriously injured, but his energy has been almost drained, and he has reached the point where he has run out of gas.
Luo Kun was not willing to die in the bloody mouth of the desolate beast. He dragged his seriously injured body and fled in embarrassment, trying to find other strong men from nearby alliances who were acting alone to seek shelter.
The only good thing is that the five mid-level ninth-level desolate beasts behind him, although they chased him very quickly at the beginning, have been chasing him for two full days, and now they are not much faster than him.
If you are lucky and can meet a helper who is willing to help you before being caught up, you may still have a glimmer of hope...
Originally, Luo Kun was still driven by the desire to survive. He endured the severe pain and ran away with all his strength, not only for the obsession of one day escaping from this ghost place and seeing the light of day again, but also for the unfulfilled wish in his heart.
However, when he felt an unprecedented tyrannical pressure coming from in front of him and approaching him at a terrifying speed, Luo Kun's heart suddenly sank, and his face was completely despairing.
"This coercion...is it the aura of a Martial Emperor?"
Luo Kun's face turned pale, and he murmured to himself as if he was a mere first-order mid-level martial saint. Do I need to go out to intercept and kill the tenth-level desolate beast? This is too flattering to me, Luo Kun. Could it be that I am just unlucky? Anyway, there is nothing to be unwilling to die in the hands of the tenth-level desolate beast king with the strength of the Martial Emperor. Father and mother, see you in the next life!"
Luo Kun closed his eyes and waited quietly for death.
Facing such a powerful enemy, he couldn't even muster the courage to resist.
